kurals.tr: Thannoon Perukkarkuth Thaanpiridhu Oonunpaan / Engnganam Aalum Arul?
kurals.m: How can he be possessed of kindness, who to increase his own flesh, eats the flesh of other creatures

kurals.tr: Porulaatchi Potraadhaarkku Illai Arulaatchi / Aangillai Oondhin Pavarkku
kurals.m: As those possess no property who do not take care of it, so those possess no kindness who feed on flesh

kurals.tr: Pataikontaar Nenjampol Nannookkaadhu Ondran / Utalsuvai Untaar Manam
kurals.m: Like the (murderous) mind of him who carries a weapon (in his hand), the mind of him who feasts with pleasure on the body of another (creature), has no regard for goodness

kurals.tr: Arulalladhu Yaadhenin Kollaamai Koral / Porulalladhu Avvoon Thinal
kurals.m: If it be asked what is kindness and what its opposite, the answer would be preservation and destruction of life; and therefore it is not right to feed on the flesh (obtained by taking away life)

kurals.tr: Unnaamai Ulladhu Uyirnilai Oonunna / Annaaththal Seyyaadhu Alaru
kurals.m: Not to eat flesh contributes to the continuance of life; therefore if a man eat flesh, hell will not open its mouth (to let him escape out, after he has once fallen in)

kurals.tr: Thinarporuttaal Kollaadhu Ulakenin Yaarum / Vilaipporuttaal Oondraruvaa Ril
kurals.m: If the world does not destroy life for the purpose of eating, then no one would sell flesh for the sake of money

kurals.tr: Unnaamai Ventum Pulaaal Piridhondran / Punnadhu Unarvaarp Perin
kurals.m: If men should come to know that flesh is nothing but the unclean ulcer of a body, let them abstain from eating it

kurals.tr: Seyirin Thalaippirindha Kaatchiyaar Unnaar / Uyirin Thalaippirindha Oon
kurals.m: The wise, who have freed themselves from mental delusion, will not eat the flesh which has been severed from an animal

kurals.tr: Avisorin Thaayiram Vettalin Ondran / Uyirsekuth Thunnaamai Nandru
kurals.m: Not to kill and eat (the flesh of) an animal, is better than the pouring forth of ghee etc, in a thousand sacrifices

kurals.tr: Kollaan Pulaalai Maruththaanaik Kaikooppi / Ellaa Uyirun Thozhum
kurals.m: All creatures will join their hands together, and worship him who has never taken away life, nor eaten flesh
